status: own-source qualification and metadata projection completed; technical acceptance is separately recorded

qualification.frequency_conflict: Own RMs require actual 4..32 MHz; own DS external-input tables state 1..32 MHz. Admit their intersection 4..32 MHz including complete board-guaranteed minimum and maximum, never nominal frequency alone.
qualification.conditions: Use own general supply 1.65..5.5 V and conservative ambient -40..105 C. The conditional low-power 125 C extension is not adopted; retained factory HSI is qualified only through 105 C.
qualification.waveform: All waveform limits apply together at the pad. Duty is 40..60 percent; each high/low pulse is at least 15 ns; each rise/fall is at most 20 ns. At 32 MHz, 40 percent gives 12.5 ns and is therefore insufficient. DS waveform characteristics are guaranteed by design, not production-tested.
qualification.levels: high_level_vddio_percent is 70..100; low_level_vddio_percent is 0..30, where 0 denotes VSS and percentages are relative to VSS. Own I/O and absolute-maximum limits also apply.
qualification.accuracy: No default ppm or inherited HSI accuracy. Board guarantees include temperature, supply, aging, load and short-term cycle variation across declared operating conditions.
qualification.pins: Own datasheet Table 5-2 labels HEX_PB00 and HEX_PB01 in PB00/PB01 rows. These reviewed routes are peripheral-controlled inputs without numbered AFs. Existing independently reviewed physical pinouts determine exact-package availability; aliases retain the common GPIO intersection. Physical pinout catalogs are unchanged.
qualification.clock_loss: STABLE is a startup latch, not continuous clock-loss detection. No usable CCS, automatic fallback or PLL mechanism is documented for this pair; copied SDK CCS/LSELOCK helpers do not authorize writes to reserved CR1 bits.
qualification.retained_awt: AWT SRC=2/3 independently selects PB00/PB01. HEXEN=0 or a different system PINMUX does not prove the other AWT input pad is unused.

awt_curation.scope: Complete documented Source enum with LSI=1, HEX_PB00=2, HEX_PB01=3 and ETR=4. Preserve the existing HSIOSC=0 encoding and all register layout/access/other enums.
awt_curation.prior_review_context: The Stage27 HSE review kept awt_v1 unchanged while splitting F020/x030 semantics. This own-source HEX review supersedes that historical unchanged statement only for the newly reviewed F002/F003 Source names. hse-qualified.yaml and the separate HSE-family AWT definition remain unchanged.

validation: Direct own-PDF text inspection; all four actual PDF SHA256 hashes matched canonical selected own-family authority. Generator/PAC and production ARM verification are separate evidence, not silicon validation.
projection_disposition: Original physical pinout catalogs remain byte-exact. HEX_PB00/PB01 routes are authored in hex-qualified.yaml, projected through electrical.rs, then intersected with the existing exact-package/common-alias GPIO pin sets.
